digest.component_or_area: test suite / build provenance and shipped surface contracts
propositions: shipped-surface contract test decodes arbitrary working-tree files including ignored non-UTF-8 binaries under src/rebar, raising UnicodeDecodeError instead of scanning only tracked textual artifacts
provenance fallback test clones the source object database and fails on shallow promisor checkouts with unavailable historical objects, conflating shallow-clone environments with test failures
shipped-surface oracle must still fail when stale/retired tokens appear in tracked text files even after scanning only tracked artifacts via git ls-files
provenance fallback oracle must still prove git rev-parse --short HEAD is embedded in the wheel via the hook when REBAR_BUILD_COMMIT is unset, even when using a minimal fixture with no source cloning
tests must pass in both full and shallow/promisor checkout fixtures without silently narrowing scan scope or unconditionally skipping assertions
